recipes.title: Classic Cheese Omelette
steps: Whisk 3 eggs with a splash of milk, salt and pepper.
Melt butter in a non-stick pan over medium heat.
Pour in the eggs and let them set for 30 seconds, then gently push the edges in.
Scatter grated cheese over one half, fold, and slide onto a plate.

recipes.title: Fluffy Buttermilk Pancakes
steps: Mix flour, sugar, a pinch of salt and baking powder in a bowl.
Whisk in milk, an egg and melted butter until just combined.
Ladle batter onto a hot greased pan; flip when bubbles form on top.
Cook until golden and serve with syrup or fruit.

recipes.title: Avocado Toast with Egg
steps: Toast two slices of bread until crisp.
Mash avocado with a squeeze of lemon, salt and chili flakes.
Fry or poach an egg to your liking.
Spread the avocado on the toast and top with the egg.

recipes.title: Quick Vegetable Fried Rice
steps: Heat oil in a wok and scramble a beaten egg, then set aside.
Fry diced onion, garlic, carrot and peas until tender.
Add cold cooked rice and stir-fry over high heat.
Return the egg, splash in soy sauce, and toss to combine.

recipes.title: Spaghetti Aglio e Olio
steps: Cook spaghetti in well-salted water until al dente.
Gently warm sliced garlic and chili flakes in olive oil — don't brown.
Toss the drained pasta in the oil with a splash of pasta water.
Finish with chopped parsley and serve.

recipes.title: Chicken & Pepper Stir-Fry
steps: Slice chicken thin and sear in a hot oiled pan until golden.
Add onion, peppers, garlic and ginger; stir-fry until crisp-tender.
Pour in soy sauce and a splash of water, simmer 2 minutes.
Serve over steamed rice.

recipes.title: Tomato & Basil Soup
steps: Soften onion and garlic in a pot with a little oil.
Add chopped tomatoes and stock; simmer 20 minutes.
Blend smooth, stir in basil and a swirl of cream.
Season and serve with crusty bread.

recipes.title: Cheesy Veggie Frittata
steps: Soften diced potato, onion and pepper in an oven-proof pan.
Beat eggs with milk, cheese, salt and pepper.
Pour over the vegetables and cook until the edges set.
Finish under a hot grill until puffed and golden.

recipes.title: 5-Minute Chocolate Mug Cake
steps: Stir flour, sugar, cocoa and baking powder in a large mug.
Mix in milk and oil until smooth.
Microwave on high for about 90 seconds until risen.
Let cool a minute and enjoy warm.

recipes.title: Simple Banana Bread
steps: Mash ripe bananas and mix with melted butter, sugar and an egg.
Fold in flour and baking soda until just combined.
Pour into a lined loaf tin.
Bake at 175°C / 350°F for about 50 minutes until a skewer comes out clean.

recipes.title: Apple Oat Crumble
steps: Toss sliced apples with sugar and cinnamon in a baking dish.
Rub butter into flour, oats and sugar to make a crumble.
Scatter the crumble over the fruit.
Bake at 180°C / 350°F for 30 minutes until golden and bubbling.

recipes.title: Berry Yogurt Parfait
steps: Spoon a layer of yogurt into a glass.
Add a layer of berries and a drizzle of honey.
Sprinkle granola or oats.
Repeat the layers and serve chilled.
